title: Gale's Equine Factory
specs: Licensed United States Pony Club center teaching the Pony Club way
Certified instructor with American Riding Instructors Association
Minimum recommended age 8 years for regular lessons; Tiny Trotters for ages 3-7
Parental involvement required for children under 16 in ground work
Weight limit approximately 185 pounds for rider due to horse carrying capacity
Riders must wear ASTM approved equestrian helmets (provided or bring your own)
Dress code: T-shirts or well covering shirts, long pants for riding, no flip-flops or sandals
Good physical health recommended; ability to carry saddle (20-30 pounds)
Group lessons provide social riding experience and longer horse-contact time
includes: Instruction in grooming, tacking, riding, and horse care
Use of indoor and outdoor arenas, cross country jumps, and trails
Fitting and use of ASTM approved riding helmets
gap: Exact cancellation and refund policy details not stated
blurb: Gale's Equine Facility offers riding lessons for all levels and ages, emphasizing horsemanship including grooming, tacking, and horse care. Lessons include safety protocols and riding skills, taught in indoor and outdoor arenas. The facility is licensed with the United States Pony Club and follows the Pony Club way for humane and correct riding.
extraNote: Liability release must be signed before activities · Lessons rarely canceled due to weather; may cancel for extreme cold for young children · COVID-19 and bio-security protocols in place; disinfect clothing and footwear before visit · At the stable known as "Hunter Run" · Year round
